items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: Yeah, Cab Calloway. That was my first big band.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think, did you belong to any big band during the 30s? Yes, Cab Calloway.
That's what I was trying to think of. Yeah, Cab Calloway. That was my first big band.
Who's the other bass player? Is Rhythm in New York now? Oh, Hinton. Milton Hinton, yeah.
